policy: v4 长镜头·首尾帧约束（H3 fl2va，训练范围 124–362 帧）。只做少量：一条同空间位移（安全件），一条时空过渡（有野心）。length=192 ≈ 8s，在 16G 卡安全区内（判例：>10s 单镜曾三次压死 ComfyUI）。全部单光源、无对白、无剪辑。

units.note: 同空间位移：从展厅远端走到展柜前。替代'远景+中景+近景'三拼接，一条过。首尾同人同衣，身份不会漂。
units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. A slow, steady dolly follows a young woman in a cream knit sweater from behind as she walks into a dim museum gallery, past tall illuminated display cases on both sides. The camera moves with her at an even pace, keeping her in the middle third of frame; she slows as she nears a case holding a dark carved stele and comes to a halt, her shoulder settling. Ceiling spots make soft pools on the floor; the case glass carries a faint warm reflection. She does not speak. No cuts, no zoom, continuous motion. Fine 35mm grain, black point slightly lifted.

units.note: 时空过渡：台灯下的纸面化成火光中的石面。把'他写字'与'碑'用一个镜头接上——正是叙事缺的连接件。风险最高的一条，失败即弃。
units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. The camera holds almost still, drifting in very slightly over the whole take. It begins on a writing desk under a warm tungsten reading lamp: an open notebook with handwriting, a pen resting on the page, the light pooling warmly on paper. As the take proceeds, that warm pool widens and deepens into firelight, the paper surface darkens and cools into black basalt, and shallow wedge-cut marks of a carved stele surface slowly rise out of it, each groove still holding the same warm glow. No person is visible at the end. One light source breathing from tungsten to flame; the transition is continuous with no cut and no dissolve. Fine 35mm grain, warm halation, black point slightly lifted.
